result.title: Nearest Neighbor Functional Curve Completion for Intraday Probabilistic Revisions of Renewable Generation Forecasts
result.summary: We propose a nonparametric approach that fuses deterministic initial forecasts and a partial realization into a probabilistic forecast using the framework of functional curve completion. Our motivation is to construct intra-day forecasts for renewable energy generation, which is a key operational task in modern power grids. The aim is to combine the day-ahead (DA) forecast and the morning realized generation profile to create trajectories for the rest of the day, quantifying operational uncertainty. Starting with a large database of complete forecast-actual pairs across many assets, we adopt a functional point of view and construct a weighted neighborhood based on similarity metrics for the observed partial curve, the DA forecast, the day, and the geographical location. The selected complete nearest-neighbor curves provide a full predictive distribution, including functional focal envelopes and predictive bands based on functional depth. The hyperparameters governing neighborhood size, distances, and fusion rates are tuned across forecast update times and directly target probabilistic calibration in terms of the predictive probability integral transform. Three case studies using synthetic wind and solar assets, as well as real-life regional wind generation, showcase that our algorithm is able to achieve excellent calibration.

AI.brief_summary: 提出一种非参数方法，将日前预测与当日已实现的局部曲线，通过基于相似性度量的加权近邻检索补全为完整轨迹，从而给出可再生能源日内概率预测，并用泛函深度构造预测带、以 PIT 校准调参，在合成与真实风电数据上验证校准效果。
AI.relevance_reason: 其「局部观测 + 先验预测 → 检索相似完整轨迹并按权重融合成完整假设」的思路，可能为 LVR 中部分视觉证据下的 latent 假设筛选与融合、以及预测分布校准评价提供概念类比，但领域相距较远，需核查相似性度量与融合权重的设计是否有可迁移之处。
